sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:26

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:26:1
items.html:
The place of the shells and the externals is the posterior of the Nukva of ZA, and there they cling: For the shells grip only in the place of lack, that is, in the place that does not shine, which is called the posterior — namely, specifically in the posterior of the ZAT, who are ZON; but in the GAR [first three] they have no grip at all, as above in the words of the ARI.
And in ZON, too, there is a difference between ZA and the Nukva. For their principal grip is in the Nukva of ZA, since she is the Sefira that ends the Partzuf, that is, the one that halts the light in the Partzuf so that it will not expand further, and this is by force of the restriction and the screen that are in her, as is known. Therefore her posterior is complete darkness, in the secret of “her feet go down to death,” which are the shells, called death. And this is what he says, that the place of the shells and the externals is the posterior of the Nukva of ZA, and there they cling. That is, as above, that the shells and the externals begin from the place of darkness downward, which is from the Sium [end] of the Nukva downward, for after her the darkness begins, since she is the Sium upon the light in the Partzuf.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:26:2
items.html: And indeed in the posterior of ZA too there is some grip: And this is in all that measure which does not shine, which is called the posterior; for this is the rule, that Tyre was built only out of the ruin of Jerusalem. For the whole sucking and building of the Sitra Achra [the other side] comes from the ruins of holiness. Thus, at the time when holiness will be corrected to the point that no ruin whatsoever can any longer be conceived in it, then the Sitra Achra will be annulled from the world, in the secret of the verse “He will swallow up death forever.”

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:26:3
items.html:
Before Elokim created man upon the earth, the shells had the power to suck abundance, etc.: That is to say, that then ZON could not couple face to face, since there is no coupling face to face without a raising of MAN [female waters] from the one below them. (As above, in the explanation of the fourth degree, face to face; study it there well.) And there it was explained with regard to AVI, and so too is the matter in ZON, for ZON as well are corrected in back to back by force of the posterior of Ima, as will be explained further on. Therefore the Nukva too does not cease her posterior before there is a cause that compels her to it; and this cause is the souls of the righteous, who rise to her as MAN. For in order to bestow the illumination of GAR [first three] upon them, she is compelled to cease her posterior and to turn her face toward ZA, and then she couples with ZA face to face.
And therefore, before Adam HaRishon was created, there was no one to raise MAN to the Nukva of ZA, and hence they lacked GAR, that is, the light of the face, which is the principal vitality of the Partzuf. And therefore the shells had the power to suck abundance from holiness, that is, from this very lack of the light of GAR, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:26:4
items.html: ZON emerged back to back out of fear of the externals, lest they suck: That is to say, that they emerged with the correction of the posterior of Ima; for they rose upward to AVI, and ZA was included in Aba and the Nukva of ZA in Ima, and through this they attained the posterior of Ima, which suffices for them as though it were the illumination of GAR [first three]. (As above in the Inner Light, in the degree of back to back, page 498.) And after they attained this, the externals can no longer suck from ZON, for it is reckoned to them as the light of GAR; and since there is GAR in the Partzuf, there is no longer any place for the externals to suck from there, for there is no grip except in the ZAT without GAR. See there.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:26:5
items.html:
Had they stood face to face, the shells would have had a place to grip in the place of their grip: The meaning is not that they stand in a coupling face to face, for then, on the contrary, the shells would have been driven out of ZON entirely, as above. Rather the meaning is that had they not had that correction of back to back, but the Nukva had wished to receive the light of the face of ZA, then their posterior would have been uncovered — that is, the lack of GAR [first three] in them would have been uncovered and felt — and then the shells would have had a place to grip, namely in the lack that is in them. But now that they are corrected with the posterior of Ima, which rejects the light of Hochma, that is, the light of the face, there is no lack felt in them at all by which the externals might grip there; for the lack of the light of Hochma is not reckoned to them now as any flaw, since in any case they do not desire Hochma, as above in the Inner Light, page 498.
And this is what he says: “Had they stood face to face, the shells would have had a place to grip in the place of their grip, which is the posterior, in order to suck — for from the face they could not suck.” That is, as explained, that had the anterior vessels of the Nukva been open to receive the light of the face, the lack of the light of the face would have been uncovered in them; and this lack is the posterior, in which the shells grip and from which they suck. And remember throughout all that follows that the posterior means the place of the lack of the light of Hochma, and in this form the externals have grip and sucking, for all their vitality is from the place of lack in holiness. And the opposite of this is the posterior of Ima, which is GAR — even though there too there is necessarily a lack of Hochma, for that is why it is called posterior; yet with respect to Bina this is not reckoned as any lack, since she is such from her root in the Bina of direct light, which chooses Hassadim and rejects the light of Hochma. And since Bina is herself a Sefira of the GAR, therefore her light of Hassadim is likewise reckoned as GAR. And after ZON too rise and are included in AVI, and receive from them this correction of the posterior of Ima, behold, they too attain the illumination of GAR from this posterior of Ima, and the lack of the light of the face is therefore not reckoned as a lack even in ZON, as explained. And remember this.
